messages:
jess: Following up on the postmortem for the cross-region routing flap + TLS handshake surge. Short tracker here for owners and ETAs. keep replies short.

Action items (owners / ETA):
1) controller ordering fix - ensure route reconciler writes are serialized to avoid split-paths (owner: amina) ETA: 2026-04-05
2) LB client: reduce retry fan-out by adding per-peer retry cap + jittered backoff (owner: sanjay) ETA: 2026-03-31
3) emergency mitigation feature-flag: prefer-local-on-amplify (owner: mike) ETA: 2026-03-27
4) synthetic probe + alerting: detect handshake amplification > 2x baseline (owner: jess) ETA: 2026-03-26
5) customer advisory draft for passthrough configs (owner: product@redwood) ETA: 2026-04-03

amina: ack. i'll scope controller-only change first (mutex around reconcile + write ordering). plan a small migration to reapply correct ordering. will add unit + integration tests.

sanjay: ack. plan: client cap default=6 concurrent handshakes per-peer, backoff: base=60ms, factor=2, cap=1600ms, full jitter. will put compat flag for large customers.

mike: ack. i'll implement the feature-flag gate and a simple playbook to flip it. canary region=us-west-2 for initial rollout.

jess: pagerbot -> create a 14-day recurring monitor and create ticket. deploy-bot -> start canary once PRs are ready.

pagerbot: Created followup INF-4960 assigned to jess, amina, sanjay, mike. First sync 2026-03-29 14:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: tag=reconcile-ordering.patch1 region=us-west-2 queued_ts=2839991305. Dashboard: /dashboards/routing-handshake-canary.

amina: brief repro notes: i can reproduce dual-edge when controller receives out-of-order updates from api-server during a restart window. will add a test that simulates interleaved writes.

sanjay: quick thought: also limit retries at ingress edge so passthrough clients don't amplify. adding short term override in config.

jess: mitigation note: during high amplification we should automatically prefer local region after threshold=1% error spike for 2 minutes. this is short-term and gated.

amina: pushed draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/3510 - includes reconcile mutex + integration test. requesting review from @sanjay and @mike.

sanjay: reviewing now. will add client patch reference and a perf microbenchmark to ensure latency not impacted.

mike: will prep the canary playbook steps and add rollback commands (route revert, flag off).

jess: thanks, team. update this thread with status ticks or blockers. if ETA slips, call it out so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
